ai_review.summary: Nice board captures a high‑energy second set highlighted by a seamless Dark Star transition and classic oncore jams.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the soundboard recording as “nice” with no notable flaws, and lauds the show for an exceptional second set that weaves Brokendown into a beautiful Dark Star > Deal sequence followed by Stars & Stripes, Lovelight, King Bee, Mannish Boy, Two Trains and U.B. Jesus.  The energy is described as “pure pleasure” throughout the hour‑long segment.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (especially the second set) and a clean soundboard recording give a high combined score; limited to one detailed review, so confidence is low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls it a “nice board” with no complaints, implying clear and balanced audio.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set arranged as a unique hour of pure pleasure, with smooth transitions—Brokendown into Dark Star and later Lovelight into King Bee, creating an engaging flow distinct from typical shows.
